count = 0

def bucket_max(buckets):
    for i in range(len(buckets) - 1, -1, -1):
        if buckets[i] > 0:

    return -1

i = 0
while i < len(arr) - 1:

            sum_ -= max_bucket
            buckets[max_bucket] -= 1
            buckets[diff] += 1
            sum_ += diff
        elif sum_ < B:
            sum_ += diff
            buckets[diff] += 1
            count += 1
            start = i + 1
        if i == len(arr) - 2 and k < len(arr) - 1:
            i = start
            evens = 0
            odds = 0
            continue
    i += 1

i = len(buckets) - 1
while sum_ > B:
    if buckets[i] > 0:
        sum_ -= i
        count -= 1
    else:
        i -= 1

print(count)
